system.longDesc:
Rarity: Uncommon.

This miraculous medicinal salve can rapidly heal injuries. When applied with an Activate action, it restores 6d6 + Constitution in lost Health. A single application of healing salve can be used in smaller amounts for less serious injuries—two applications restoring 3d6 Health each or three applications restoring 2d6 Health each. A container of healing salve usually has 1d6 applications.
